newsitem.title: DENMARK: Maersk sells drilling rigs to U.S. firm.
newsitem.headline: Maersk sells drilling rigs to U.S. firm.

text.p: Danish shipping and energy group Maersk, a subsidiary of the A.P. Moeller group, said on Monday it confirmed the sale of two semi-submersible drilling rigs to U.S. Global Marine for a total of $250 million.
It said that the deal embraced the sale to Global Marine of the two drilling rigs Maersk Jutlander for $100 million and Maersk Vinlander for a further $150 million.
The rigs, built in 1982 and 1984 respectively, were sold by the Maersk subsidiaries Tank-og Ruteskibe and Maersk Line Limited (Panama) to the U.S. firm, it said.
The Maersk Jutlander drilling rig would be returned to Tank-og Ruteskibe on bareboat leasing contract after three and a half years on contract in Norway, Maersk said.
